from gurobipy import *

def solve_problem():

    m = Model("Optimization_Problem")

    # 2. Variables
    vars = {}
    lin_expr = 0
    vars['Var_0'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=14.7, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name='Var_0')
    lin_expr += 8.52 * vars['Var_0']
    vars['Var_1'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=7.81, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name='Var_1')
    lin_expr += 5.82 * vars['Var_1']
    vars['Var_2'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=6.93, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name='Var_2')
    lin_expr += 3.6 * vars['Var_2']
    vars['Var_3'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=11.4, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name='Var_3')
    lin_expr += 7.89 * vars['Var_3']
    vars['Var_4'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=19.45, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name='Var_4')
    lin_expr += 6.42 * vars['Var_4']
    vars['Var_5'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=17.1, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name='Var_5')
    lin_expr += 2.03 * vars['Var_5']
    vars['Var_6'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=10.23, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name='Var_6')
    lin_expr += 6.0 * vars['Var_6']
    vars['Var_7'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=7.46, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name='Var_7')
    lin_expr += 4.49 * vars['Var_7']

    m.setObjective(lin_expr, GRB.MINIMIZE)

    # 3. Constraints
    m.addConstr(7.36 * vars['Var_5'] >= -0.19, name='C0')
    m.addConstr(8.7 * vars['Var_0'] + 8.99 * vars['Var_5'] + 6.0 * vars['Var_6'] >= 83.28, name='C1')
    m.addConstr(8.54 * vars['Var_1'] >= 5.7, name='C2')
    m.addConstr(0.31 * vars['Var_4'] + 1.35 * vars['Var_5'] >= -0.17, name='C3')
    m.addConstr(8.34 * vars['Var_2'] + 4.35 * vars['Var_4'] + -1.8 * vars['Var_5'] >= 24.58, name='C4')
    m.addConstr(-3.71 * vars['Var_2'] + 0.13 * vars['Var_5'] + 6.18 * vars['Var_6'] >= -2.09, name='C5')
    m.addConstr(9.83 * vars['Var_0'] + 3.62 * vars['Var_1'] + -0.57 * vars['Var_5'] >= 91.33, name='C6')
    m.addConstr(6.68 * vars['Var_0'] + -0.3 * vars['Var_3'] + 0.27 * vars['Var_4'] + -4.11 * vars['Var_6'] >= 59.34, name='C7')
    m.addConstr(8.61 * vars['Var_2'] + 6.33 * vars['Var_3'] + -3.48 * vars['Var_4'] + -2.53 * vars['Var_5'] + -3.55 * vars['Var_6'] >= -7.34, name='C8')
    m.addConstr(2.94 * vars['Var_0'] + 0.63 * vars['Var_3'] + 8.39 * vars['Var_5'] + 8.56 * vars['Var_7'] >= 79.34, name='C9')

    # 4. Optimize
    m.optimize()
    return m
